title: index.embedding.requested payload (v1)
description: Payload of the index.embedding.requested outbox event. Producer: app/outbox/events.py::emit_index_embedding_requested (payload = {object_id}; other fields ride in meta). Consumer: app/indexer/consumer.py::process_event via app/indexer/consumer.py::_extract_object_id, which requires payload.object_id and raises ValueError('index.embedding.requested missing payload.object_id') when absent. Requires object_id so the consumer can locate the object to embed.
